description: Asks, on a writable copy, which referential-action spellings ALTER TABLE ... ADD CONSTRAINT ... FOREIGN KEY accepts through Database.Execute (dbFailOnError) and what they do: none, ON DELETE and ON UPDATE with CASCADE, SET NULL, NO ACTION, SET DEFAULT and RESTRICT, both clauses together and a repeated clause. For each variant i the parent Fp<i> (rows 1, 2) and child Fc<i> (rows 10 -> 1, 11 -> 2) are created, then the parent row 1 is deleted and the parent row 2 renumbered to 9, and both tables are read. Further forms: NO INDEX, a missing referenced column list, a repeated referenced column, an unknown parent and column, a non-unique parent column, a self reference and a repeated constraint name. Finally the Relations (Name, Table, ForeignTable, Attributes) are read. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.

CREATE TABLE Fc0 (CID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Fc0 PRIMARY KEY, PID LONG)
ALTER TABLE Fc0 ADD CONSTRAINT FK_0 FOREIGN KEY (PID) REFERENCES Fp0 (ID)
INSERT INTO Fp0 (ID) VALUES (1)
INSERT INTO Fp0 (ID) VALUES (2)
INSERT INTO Fc0 (CID, PID) VALUES (10, 1)
INSERT INTO Fc0 (CID, PID) VALUES (11, 2)
DELETE FROM Fp0 WHERE ID = 1
UPDATE Fp0 SET ID = 9 WHERE ID = 2
SELECT CID, PID FROM Fc0 ORDER BY CID
